headlines.abstract: The Biden administration is taking steps to avoid a spike in gas prices as officials consider the potential consequences for American consumers.

headlines.title: Russia Batters Ukraine With Artillery Strikes as West Condemns Invasion
headlines.abstract: Explosions were reported over Kyiv, the capital. Several countries announced severe new sanctions, as Vladimir Putin remained resolute about his decision to invade.
